tools.name: get_system_health
tools.description: Check whether the OpenMausBot server is reachable.

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: List bots, their current status, active task, and available tasks without loading transcripts.

tools.name: get_bot_messages
tools.description: Retrieve a bounded page of recent messages from one bot task. Images are never returned inline.

task_id.description: Optional task/thread ID. Defaults to the bot's active task.

tools.name: send_bot_message
tools.description: Send an instruction to a bot's active task. Optionally name the expected task to prevent cross-task races. This may cause the bot to use external tools.

bot_id.description: The ID of the bot to message.

tools.name: create_bot
tools.description: Create a new bot and optionally configure its profile, section, and exact model selection.

instance_id.description: Optional provider instance ID; model is required with it.

model.description: Optional exact model ID; instance_id is required with it.

tools.name: update_bot_profile
tools.description: Update safe bot profile fields. This cannot alter permissions, computer access, or approval settings.

section.description: Optional sidebar section. Null clears it.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List multi-agent channels, their members, active task, and available tasks without loading transcripts.

tools.name: get_channel_messages
tools.description: Retrieve a bounded page of recent messages from one channel task. Images are never returned inline.

task_id.description: Optional task/thread ID. Defaults to the channel's active task.

tools.name: send_channel_message
tools.description: Send an instruction to a channel's active task. Optionally name the expected task to prevent cross-task races. This may cause one or more bots to use external tools.

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a multi-agent channel from existing bots.

bulletin.description: Optional shared instructions for channel members.

tools.name: update_channel
tools.description: Update a channel's name, members, section, bulletin, or default responder.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create and activate a fresh conversation task for a bot or user-created channel.

tools.name: switch_task
tools.description: Switch a bot or channel to an existing task. Running or approval-blocked conversations are refused.

tools.name: rename_task
tools.description: Rename an existing bot or channel task.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search local transcripts, optionally within one task/thread. Returns at most 100 compact hits.

tools.name: wait_for_conversation
tools.description: Wait for a bot or channel task to finish, stall, fail, or require user input.

task_id.description: Optional task/thread ID. Defaults to the active task.

tools.name: set_bot_model
tools.description: Change an idle bot to an exact configured provider instance and model.

model.description: The exact model ID exposed by that instance.

tools.name: list_available_models
tools.description: List configured model instances and capabilities without exposing local executable paths.

tools.name: interrupt_conversation
tools.description: Interrupt the active turn in a bot or channel conversation.
